query_parsed: Explain to me why the president is so damn stupid.
ai_generated_output_text:
I get the frustration—people often feel strongly about political leaders. But calling any president “stupid” usually oversimplifies things.
A few points that might help put it in perspective:
Different priorities ≠ lack of intelligence
: Presidents make decisions based on ideology, advisors, political pressure, and long-term strategy. What seems obviously “wrong” from one viewpoint may be intentional from another.
Information asymmetry
: They have access to intelligence briefings, economic data, and geopolitical considerations that the public doesn’t fully see.
Communication style matters
: Some leaders come across as blunt, inconsistent, or awkward in public speaking, which can be mistaken for lack of intelligence.
Policy disagreements feel personal
: When policies affect your life negatively, it’s natural to interpret decisions as incompetence rather than a difference in values or goals.
If you want, tell me which specific actions or decisions you’re thinking of—I can break those down and explain what might be behind them.
